mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 0.3 percentage points signals weakening labor demand, which reduces corporate earnings and triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) exceeding 2% year-over-year signals deteriorating household demand, which depresses earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where RSAFS YoY change < -2% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly contraction in industrial production exceeding 0.5% signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where INDPRO monthly change < -0.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in nonfarm payrolls above 0.5% signals robust labor demand, which boosts earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline in periods where PAYEMS monthly change > 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the federal funds rate above 0.25 percentage points signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where FEDFUNDS monthly change > 0.25% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in the Housing Starts Index (HOUST) exceeding 5% signals weakening residential demand, which reduces construction sector earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where HOUST monthly change < -5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 1% signals strengthening household demand, which boosts earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline in periods where RSAFS monthly change > 1% (t-test p > 0.05).
